svg.title: Febin Renu: an auto-playing pixel level
svg.desc: A pixel-art runner crosses a scrolling city on top of a contribution graph. He jumps over bugs named after failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, uncalibrated probability, dropped exception, uncited clause, straight-line guess) and each is answered by the fix (honest no, quarantined, calibrated, composed, span verified, priced). He bumps question blocks that pop coins named EVORA, PARALLAX, RECLAIM, SCOPECOMPOSE, PRISM and ASSETSTREAM. A coin counter ticks up in the corner.
